scientific_integrity.claim: For two independent hyperbolic-area-uniform points in any fixed convex all-ideal polygon, the ambient distance survival is C(P) R exp(-R) + O_P(exp(-R)), with explicit shape-dependent C(P); ideal quadrilaterals have sharp minimum 8/pi^2 uniquely at the regular ideal quadrilateral.
limitations: fixed-polygon remainder; no uniform degeneration control
scientific_integrity.numerical_checks: finite Monte Carlo and deterministic coefficient/chart checks corroborate, not prove, the asymptotics

title: Cusp-pair tails for random distances in ideal hyperbolic polygons
